trap.label: por hora
trap.wrong: Heat no faster than 100 °C by hour.
trap.right: Heat no faster than 100 °C an hour.
trap.why: Em português “100 graus por hora” usa por. O aluno usa by. Em inglês, a taxa é an hour/per hour.

mcq.q: Which phrase sets a safe heating limit?

fix.wrong: Dip each piece in the glaze, then to fire it.
fix.right: Dip each piece in the glaze, then fire it.

fix.wrong: Never to open the kiln above 200 °C.
The stoneware clay need slow heating.
fix.right: The stoneware clay needs slow heating.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com an hour: “100 °C per hour”

rewrite.answer: Heat no faster than 100 °C an hour.
